capabilities: Star, archive, or mark Medianoche articles for deletion from their notes
Detect Medianoche article notes via the medianoche_id frontmatter field
Trigger triage actions through commands and hotkeys
Keep Medianoche AI Summary and AI Comments visible with the article
disambiguation: Not a vault or device sync tool; it only syncs article triage status with the Medianoche desktop app.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The plugin itself does not fetch RSS feeds or create article notes; all reading, extraction, and export is done by the Medianoche desktop app.
problem: Article notes exported from Medianoche are ordinary Markdown files, so there is no way to act on their reader status (star, archive, delete) from inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Medianoche Sync is the official Obsidian companion plugin for Medianoche

requires.name: Medianoche desktop app with Obsidian Sync enabled

summary: Companion plugin for the Medianoche desktop reader that adds star, archive, and delete triage actions to its exported article notes.
